integrity: The proof is an analytic ellipsoid-optimization argument. Rational finite verification is corroboration rather than universal proof. There is residual risk of an equivalent older formulation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for balanced real four-point two-level ultrametrics only; asymmetric clusters, larger metric spaces, complex scalars and an attained limit at t=0 are not asserted.
title: Exact Hilbert distortion of a balanced four-point ultrametric
